name: Adel Nares
source:
"My name is Adel Nares. But you don't have to remember it. I usually don't even go inside the Royal City..."

He is the eldest son of a very poor family living in Samari Village, Shimominku.

He is a gentle and caring person who takes care of his nine younger siblings.

He is unable to attend school due to his poverty, but this changes when he meets Cecilia.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/tsuitsui/chara/]official website[/url]]
